caption: Figure 3.2 Bryophytes: A liverwort - Marchantia (a) Female thallus  (b) Male thallus Mosses -  (c) Funaria, gametophyte and sporophyte  (d) Sphagnum gametophyte
note: Four panels. Panel (a) labels: Archegoniophore, Gemma cup, Rhizoids. Panel (b) labels: Antheridiophore, Gemma cup, Rhizoids. Panel (c) labels: bracket labels Sporophyte and Gametophyte at left, and Capsule, Seta, Leaves, Main axis, Rhizoids at right. Panel (d) labels: Antheridial branch, Branches, Archegonial branch. In the caption 'Marchantia', 'Funaria' and 'Sphagnum' are printed in italics, and the dashes are en dashes. Caption fully inside the frame; a clipped line of body text above the figure ('commonly growing in moist shaded areas in the hills (Figure 3.2).') belongs to the preceding paragraph.
